# Graph operations · shape

Ports, defaults, and constraints come from the registered operations. Use `graph describe <op> --json` for the full structured record.

### shape.define

Validate and preserve an editable signed planar shape definition.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `definition` | `record` | `{"type":"rectangle","radius":0.1}` | {"layout":"Plain named object","types":["rectangle","disc","polygon","star","linear","radial","spot","stroke","gradient","symbol","bevel"]} |
| Output | `value` | `shape2d` | — | {"layout":"Serializable planar geometry, profile, symbol or bevel definition"} |

Guides: [guide](../material-shape-library.md), [guide](../material-tile-generator.md)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe shape.define --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### shape.field

Use an analytic signed shape or profile in procedural sampling.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `shape2d` | Required | {"layout":"Serializable planar geometry, profile, symbol or bevel definition"} |
| Output | `value` | `field` | — | {"layout":"Function or native object with a sample method"} |
| Output | `profile` | `field` | — | {"layout":"Function or native object with a sample method"} |
| Output | `height` | `field` | — | {"layout":"Function or native object with a sample method"} |

- The primary field is signed distance, with negative values inside. Profile is clipped to the shape.
- Height is zero unless the definition carries a bevel. Coordinates are planar shape units.

Guides: [guide](../material-shape-library.md)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe shape.field --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### shape.pick

Select one editable definition by its stable shape library ID.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `shapeLibrary` | Required | {"layout":"Versioned planar shape definitions by stable ID","maxEntries":128} |
| Input | `id` | `string` | `"rectangle"` |  |
| Output | `value` | `shape2d` | — | {"layout":"Serializable planar geometry, profile, symbol or bevel definition"} |

Guides: [guide](../material-shape-library.md), [guide](../material-shape-library.md#share-shapes-across-bakes), [guide](../material-tile-generator.md)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe shape.pick --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.
